cards.title: Separate PK, potency, target and biomarker translation bridges
cards.claim: Build an explicit bridge inventory: species PK/exposure; binding/in-vitro potency normalization; target-site kinetics; target/disease biology; biomarker-to-clinical endpoint. A supported PK bridge does not establish a PD or clinical endpoint bridge. GEN003 is a named case, not a universal transfer law.
conditions: Choose the explicitly qualified branch; scientific scope and assumptions are specified in method_recipe.
required_inputs: Use the branch-specific input contract below; unknown inputs remain unknown.
limitations: Offline candidate pending source and operational review; no target-human facts, fitting or production use.
cards.downstream_use: Plan an evidence-bounded method and identify blocked dependent outputs; ContextBuilder supplies project objective separately.

method_recipe.estimand_and_scope: Build an explicit bridge inventory: species PK/exposure; binding/in-vitro potency normalization; target-site kinetics; target/disease biology; biomarker-to-clinical endpoint. A supported PK bridge does not establish a PD or clinical endpoint bridge. GEN003 is a named case, not a universal transfer law.
method_recipe.input_contract: For each intended bridge record endpoint, species, assay, timing and source-supported assumption. The scalar example conditionally needs total plasma concentration at a specified response level, compatible fu,p and in-vitro IC50. Target-site kinetics and clinical endpoint translation need their own evidence; multiple species, lognormal distributions or a specific biomarker are not universal prerequisites.
method_recipe.applicability_and_prerequisites: Qualify assay comparability, driver basis, target biology and disease state. Source-study human effect-site equality and target-response assumptions remain assumptions. Absence of visible hysteresis alone does not justify an instantaneous direct model. Do not transfer study numerical targets or human findings to the current target drug.
method_recipe.definitions_units_basis_window: Scalar=Cp,total*fu,p/IC50 is dimensionless only for compatible concentration units/bases. Cp and IC50 retain assay/species identity and specified PD level/window. fu,p is dimensionless. PK CL, target-site equilibration and biomarker response have separate parameters/units and may require different species bridges.
method_recipe.procedure: Create one row per bridge with input/evidence, transportability assumption, conditional output and unresolved gap. First distinguish exposure transfer from potency/binding correction, then assess kinetics/biology and endpoint meaning. If using source Eq8, compare compatible response levels; explicitly label any assumed scalar preservation. Never collapse all rows into a single validated scaling claim.
method_recipe.formula_and_parameterization: Source-specific GEN003 Eq8: scalar=(Cp,total*fu,p)/(in-vitro IC50). Algebraic scenario under an explicitly assumed equal scalar: Cp,total,h=scalar*IC50,h/fu,p,h. This only defines a conditional exposure target; it supplies neither a human PK curve nor a dose/regimen. No dose equation is introduced by this card.
method_recipe.uncertainty_and_identifiability: Record whether each uncertainty is measurement, parameter, structural or cross-species/endpoint assumption. No automatic animal-to-human fu/potency borrowing or default distribution. A deterministic conditional target has no population coverage or confidence interval without further qualified inputs.
method_recipe.diagnostics_and_failure_modes: A normalized curve overlap or biomarker change does not prove disease efficacy. Case-specific assay sensitivity, assumed ke0 transfer and incomplete endpoint links must remain visible. Check that observed source-drug human results are never described as current target-drug data.
method_recipe.missing_input_and_partial_fallback: Missing human fu or potency blocks the numeric total-plasma target in this scalar branch; retain an explicit symbolic relation or qualified available upstream result. Missing clinical endpoint link leaves a biomarker/target scenario only. Do not substitute animal values, a no-hysteresis shortcut or an invented clinical target.
method_recipe.output_and_interpretation: Return separate supported/assumed/unresolved bridges and scenario labels. Named study drugs remain in references and bounded case metadata, not general method keywords. Project-approved assumptions are supplied separately by ContextBuilder and cannot become universal library policy.
method_recipe.worked_example_and_counterexample: SYNTHETIC scalar fixture: Cp,total,a=100 nM, fu,a=0.1 and compatible IC50,a=10 nM give scalar=1. Under explicitly assumed equal scalar and independently supplied synthetic IC50,h=5 nM, fu,h=0.2, conditional total-plasma target=25 nM. This predicts no clinical benefit or dose. Counterexample: missing fu,h leaves the total-plasma target unresolved; borrowing fu,a is prohibited.

claim_support.claim: The source illustrates a scalar normalization of total plasma concentration using species-specific free fraction and in-vitro potency. Such a scalar requires its own equilibrium, matrix and potency assumptions; it is not a universal bridge.
claim_support.scope: Bounded source demonstration of separate PK scaling and PD potency/binding normalization; no compound-specific coefficient retained.

claim_support.claim: Target-site kinetics (hysteresis/ke0) and biomarker-to-clinical endpoint links are distinct, case-specific assumptions that do not automatically transfer across species or compounds.
claim_support.scope: GEN003 assumes ke0 equivalence between rhesus and human based on permeability; GEN001 clarifies that biomarkers are not valid surrogates without empirical proof of clinical benefit.
